title: Ratatoskr scope config
description: Schema for rata.toml files used by Ratatoskr. This file owns topology and eagerness: which stores exist, where they live, what is a root, and what each profile pulls. Per-file frontmatter owns self-description only (description, tags) and can never change whether a file is packed; `rata doctor` fails if it tries. Symmetrically, this file never enumerates individual files inside a store -- it names the store and the contents self-describe.

profiles.description: Named additive context overlays. Profiles are the eager selector: they decide what `pack` emits. A profile may reference a tag as a filter predicate, because the curator still decides; a file may never pull itself into a profile.

remote_files.description: Remote files to cache locally before resolution.

stores.description: Named durable data stores. Stores are the filesystem -- where bytes live -- not a selector. Declare one when its contents must be mounted, synced, scoped, or written to independently; use tags for subject-matter grouping instead. Never list the files inside a store here.

oneOf.description: Store path relative to the scope root. Equivalent to composition = replace.

include.description: Context file paths relative to the scope root.
Context file paths activated by the profile.

path.description: Store path relative to the scope root.

composition.description: How paths from matching scopes are resolved. The nearest declaration that sets this value controls it; it defaults to replace when no declaration sets one.

filename.description: Destination filename inside the cache directory.

destination.description: Optional cache directory relative to the scope root.

ttl.description: Seconds before refetching. -1 means never refetch an existing cached file.

allow_missing.description: Whether missing referenced files should be tolerated during packing and selective reads.

global_root.description: Optional override for the active global root.
